notes.title: Upcoming updates
notes.notes:
Upcoming updates with  more levels and more fun await you in Criminal bundle

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/2b5b0d996249311d5a9797e46e3885e71451e35e.png[/img]

notes.title: New masks!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/ab75c58d1a525c9a49ea0eb51baff901bb8b17eb.png[/img]
Howdy fellow criminals!

We added [b]13 different masks[/b] to Criminal Bundle. Now criminals can wear a variety of items like an alien mask, because we want to believe and the truth is out there. Other options are available too like the Ghosts, Hockey, Robber, Squarehead, fake nose and moustache...

[b]There is a mask for each kind of player.[/b] Of course, the covfefe mask is included! It's the perfect mask for when you feel "presidential".

Enjoy and have fun!

notes.title: New map is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/a894e70a82472dd8de26c6e39a0df6a96ba79161.jpg[/img]

Hi fellow criminals!
We are proud to announce that there is a [b]new map on Criminal Bundle[/b] available right now!
The Central Bank it's a brand new scenario with a medium city. This bank it's more secure than the Federal Bank (first map of the game). Criminals will have to get through some doors before they can get to the safe.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/114886d8b8060cf9cacce4e0416cd9fb67842c8e.jpg[/img]

But fear not, police will have it more difficult too. In the first map, snipers have an easy target to the safe. While we still added rooftops on the new map, it will be more difficult to shoot criminals. Police can control the main entrance but not the safe.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/c5bdfe087556039cc6b466430f3e8f7e606b519d.jpg[/img]

Also, [b]we fixed the issue with multiplayer rooms[/b]. Now if the host leaves the room, the new host can start the match. Other improvements will arrive with small updates like this one. We hope you enjoy this new map and here goes some screenshots!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/75572112016b0b55dbefd70b63cdc231102cb589.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/6ee6cc1e900bbd34b954e6af6f6ac76c2b33947d.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/580ea620c120ad315c21b2b7f79fe8d305b73c6f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Top Killers! (Scoreboard)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/91dc1643b38b6ab265af97d7fdbe84df2d9f0ad4.png[/img]

Greetings fellow criminals!
We added another feature to boost competitivity between players. Now there is a scoreboard on main menu where the top players will appear. The more you kill the more score you get and you will be higher on the rank.

These stats will reset at the beginning of each month and [b]the top player will receive a free t-shirt!.[/b]

[b]Don't forget to rob the bank too![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31577077/fe016955ee5b0f5b132769b01ede072d5815f5b2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update notes #2
notes.notes:
Hi fellow criminals!

We want our players happy and in order to improve the game we just added a major update to Criminal Bundle.

Now, you can talk with other players. Just press Ctrl key and you will hear a noise as if you were using a walkie talkie. You must keep pressing the key to speak and release it to end communication.

But maybe you prefer not to talk! If you are this kind of players we have something for you. Now there is a HUD radar that shows your teammates, your enemies and the money bag. We believe this will turn to more funny rounds. Also, we added working CCTV cameras! Now you can watch out for enemies through a couple of monitors next to the safe.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xThtatM0bgzBYVAIHS/giphy.gif[/img]

We updated the map too. Previous version may give some advantage to players on balcony inside the bank. That balcony is still on the map, but now there is a longer balcony. We did some lighting improvements.

Finally, but not less important, now bullets break most of the glass in the Bank. This will made the game fell more realistic.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xThta2fhTqXGBhVUPu/giphy.gif[/img]

We are currently working on the next update and we hope we can bring it soon!

notes.notes:
Howdy fellow criminals!
Criminal Bundle is out now! that means people can buy our game and, hopefully, have a great time playing it! We recomend you using the group community to talk with other criminals and play together!

If you are still unconvinced, check this launch trailer! You will want to buy the game!

notes.title: Update notes
notes.notes:
Hi fellow criminals (or not)!
We added some changes in the last few days and we expect to have your feedback.

List of changes:
- New feature: climb roofs.
- Better performance
- Improved map environment
- Graphics improvement
- Fixed graphics settings

Hope you like the changes and enjoy the game!
